x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

VveConfiguration.title: VveConfiguration
VveConfiguration.description: Per-body VvE statutory context: binds a governance body (the VvE) to its modelreglement preset, its breukdelen denominator, the splitsingsakte governing document (reference only, registered by the governing-documents-register capability, never duplicated here), and any per-akte majority overrides. Exactly one VveConfiguration per governance body. A governance body without a VveConfiguration is entirely unaffected by this pack (fail-soft to existing behaviour). Contains no financial ledger properties by construction.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (the VvE) this configuration binds. Required; one configuration per body.

modelRegulation.title: Modelreglement preset
modelRegulation.description: Reference to the ModelreglementPreset (1992/2006/2017) this VvE follows. Required; picked at body setup.

fractionDenominator.title: Breukdelen denominator
fractionDenominator.description: The total number of breukdelen the appartementsrechten are divided into (the fraction denominator, e.g. 10000). Required; Membership.votingWeight values are numerators over this denominator.

deedOfDivisionDocument.title: Splitsingsakte document
deedOfDivisionDocument.description: Reference to the splitsingsakte governing document registered by the governing-documents-register capability. Reference only: this pack never registers the document itself. A plain reference string (governing document uuid/slug); nil UUID placeholder until the sibling registration lands.

majorityOverrides.title: Majority overrides
majorityOverrides.description: Per-splitsingsakte deviations from the preset's category majorities. Each entry overrides the preset (but not an explicit caller-supplied threshold) for its decision category at round-open. Optional; empty when the akte follows the preset.

decisionCategory.title: Decision category
decisionCategory.description: The decision category this override applies to.

voteThreshold.title: Vote threshold
voteThreshold.description: The required majority for this category per the splitsingsakte (mirrors the VotingRound voteThreshold enum). Resolves into the existing round-open defaults; never a second threshold enum.

quorumFraction.title: Quorum fraction
quorumFraction.description: Optional quorum fraction (e.g. '2/3') required for this category per the akte. Null means no quorum beyond the body default.

deedArticle.title: Akte article
deedArticle.description: Free-text source note naming the splitsingsakte article this deviation stems from.

VveDecisionTemplate.title: VveDecisionTemplate
VveDecisionTemplate.description: Statutory content for a VvE ALV decision: name, proposed besluittekst, decision category, and default required majority/quorum sourced from the modelreglementen. Distinct from ProcessTemplate (which models a state machine): this is decision content, instantiated into an ordinary Decision object, decision lifecycle, routes, and voting stay in the existing decision model, never forked. Built-in seeds (builtIn: true) are read-only-but-duplicable exactly like ProcessTemplateService built-ins.

decisionCategory.title: Decision category
decisionCategory.description: The VvE statutory decision category this template represents. Required; drives majority resolution against the preset/override.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of when this template applies.

proposedText.title: Proposed text
proposedText.description: The standard Dutch besluittekst pre-filled into the Decision when instantiated (may carry placeholders like {boekjaar}).
proposedText.example: De vergadering verleent het bestuur decharge over het boekjaar {boekjaar}.

builtIn.title: Built-in
builtIn.description: Read-only built-in template shipped with the app. Edit/delete are refused server-side; duplicate is allowed (clears this flag).

defaultVoteThreshold.title: Default vote threshold
defaultVoteThreshold.description: Default required majority for this category (mirrors the VotingRound voteThreshold enum). The lowest precedence tier: caller > akte override > preset > this default.

defaultQuorumFraction.title: Default quorum fraction
defaultQuorumFraction.description: Optional default quorum fraction (e.g. '2/3'). Null means no quorum beyond the body default.

regulationSource.title: Reglement source
regulationSource.description: Free text naming the modelreglement article (or BW/Woningwet source) this template's majority derives from. Flagged for juridical review before release.

ModelreglementPreset.title: ModelreglementPreset
ModelreglementPreset.description: A modelreglement voting-rule preset (1992/2006/2017): maps VvE decision categories to their required voteThreshold and quorumFraction per that modelreglement, each mapping carrying its article reference. A VvE picks its preset via VveConfiguration.modelreglement and may deviate per splitsingsakte via majorityOverrides. Built-in seeds (builtIn: true) are read-only-but-duplicable exactly like ProcessTemplateService built-ins. Resolution feeds the existing round-open defaults; this introduces no second threshold enum, tally path, or quorum calculator.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of the modelreglement version and scope.

builtIn.title: Built-in
builtIn.description: Read-only built-in preset shipped with the app. Edit/delete are refused server-side; duplicate is allowed (clears this flag).

categoryRules.title: Category rules
categoryRules.description: Mapping of decision categories to their required majority/quorum per this modelreglement. Each rule names its article reference.

decisionCategory.title: Decision category
decisionCategory.description: The decision category this rule maps ('overige' is the catch-all default).

voteThreshold.title: Vote threshold
voteThreshold.description: The required majority for this category per the modelreglement (mirrors the VotingRound voteThreshold enum).

quorumFraction.title: Quorum fraction
quorumFraction.description: Optional quorum fraction (e.g. '2/3') required for this category. Null means no quorum beyond the body default.

article.title: Article
article.description: Free-text modelreglement article reference this rule derives from. Flagged for juridical review before release.

KascommissieVerklaring.title: KascommissieVerklaring
KascommissieVerklaring.description: The kascommissie's verklaring over a boekjaar: its verdict (goedkeurend / met-voorbehoud / afkeurend), toelichting, a link to the jaarrekening agenda item, and its verslag uploaded as an OpenRegister FileService attachment (no app-local file storage). Referenced by the decharge Decision for that boekjaar and surfaced to the meeting; a missing or afkeurend verklaring produces a visible warning but never a hard block (the ALV remains sovereign, BW 2:48). The verklaring outlives the agenda item and may be recorded before the ALV agenda exists.

financialYear.title: Boekjaar
financialYear.description: The financial year (boekjaar) the verklaring covers. Required.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: The kascommissie's verdict on the administration. Required.

notes.title: Toelichting
notes.description: Free-text explanation of the verdict (e.g. the voorbehoud). Optional.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Reference to the jaarrekening AgendaItem of the ALV this verklaring is linked to. Optional (a verklaring may be recorded before the agenda exists).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (the VvE) this verklaring belongs to. Required.
